dataset_a.reason: Every populated class has one original template and all remaining files are derived augmentations; exact duplicate content also crosses labels. An image-level split would leak source templates and contradictory content across evaluation partitions.

threshold_calibration.reason: No independent reviewed unseen/calibration dataset exists; the locked V2 test set is prohibited for threshold selection.

few_shot_experiment.reason: No defensible unseen class has independent reference and query groups.

required_additional_data.minimum_content: Independently photographed road signs from at least one class outside the 17 V2 classes, with corrected human-reviewed labels.
required_additional_data.group_requirement: For each unseen class, acquire at least 15 independent perceptual/source groups as an operational minimum (up to 5 reference, at least 5 calibration, and at least 5 query groups); larger samples are needed for stable metrics and repeated reference selections.
required_additional_data.calibration_requirement: Separate base-known and unknown calibration images not drawn from the locked V2 test split.
required_additional_data.evaluation_requirement: Independent query images never used as prototype references or threshold-calibration samples.
